claims: The final round of the 2026 Masters is on Sunday, April 12.
Early streaming for the 2026 Masters on Sunday, April 12 begins at 10:15 a.m. ET on Masters.com and the Masters App.
CBS TV coverage for the final round of the 2026 Masters runs from 2 p.m. to 7 p.m. ET.
Featured Groups streaming for the final round of the 2026 Masters on Sunday, April 12 is from 9:20 a.m. to 7 p.m. ET on Paramount+, Masters.com, and the Masters App.
Amen Corner streaming for the final round of the 2026 Masters on Sunday, April 12 is from 11:15 a.m. to 6 p.m. ET on Paramount+ and the Masters App.
Early Coverage streaming for the final round of the 2026 Masters on Sunday, April 12 is at 12 p.m. ET on Paramount+.
Round 4 Encore of the 2026 Masters airs on Sunday, April 12 at 8 p.m. ET on CBS Sports Network.
TV coverage for Thursday and Friday of the 2026 Masters airs on ESPN from 3 p.m. to 7:30 p.m. ET.
Third round TV coverage of the 2026 Masters on Saturday is on CBS from 3 p.m. to 7 p.m. ET.
